summary.text: Rebecca Schmoe is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 59 who has represented the district since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Rebecca Schmoe has served on the board of the Kansas State Rifle Association and has been affiliated with 1 Million Moms Against Gun Control and Ottawa Veterans Celebration and Events.
She succeeded Blaine Finch in the District 59 seat and took office on January 9, 2023.

In the 2025-2026 session Schmoe was assigned to the House Education, K-12 Education Budget and House Federal and State Affairs committees, and she is vice chair of the House Federal and State Affairs Committee.
She faces Democrat Michael Lewis in the general election.
